# 用原始 Si 结构检查波矢换基: # Check reciprocal basis changes with an original Si structure
从[结构转换工作台](../#structure)载入 Phonopy 的 Si: Load the Phonopy Si reference file from the [structure conversion workbench](../#structure). The input is a conventional cubic cell with eight Si atoms and a lattice length of about 5.466 Å. Select reciprocal fractional input coordinates `k=(1/2,0,0)` and a position tolerance of `10⁻⁵ Å`, then run the conversion. First predict the coordinates of the same physical wave vector in the BC primitive basis.
空间群识别得到 227，国际短符号为 Fd−3m。BC 原胞含 2 个原子，体积: The structure is identified as space group 227, with the short international symbol Fd−3m. The BC primitive cell contains two atoms and has one quarter of the input cell volume. Fractional positions, atom indices, and the origin change with the cell. Inspect the matrix `M` and shift `q` from the conversion, then examine the accompanying reciprocal basis change.
对于这份文件和上面的输入，工作台给出的 BC 波矢为 `(0,1/4,1/4)`: For this file and input, the workbench gives the BC wave vector `(0,1/4,1/4)`. The inner product of the wave vector and a given real-space displacement is the same in both bases, so the translation phase is the same.
## 用表示计算检查相同数字的误读: ## Compare representations after reusing the input coordinates
确认结构结果后，将空间群和已转换波矢带入计算中心，手动运行单值表示。记录 k 星: Send the confirmed space group and converted wave vector to the calculation center and run the single-valued representation calculation. Record the number of k-star arms and the order of the little group. Then enter `(1/2,0,0)` as BC primitive-cell coordinates and calculate again.

两组计算各自满足其小群的检验。比较它们可以发现，只把三位数字复制到另一套倒易基底: Both calculations satisfy their respective little-group checks. Comparing them shows that copying the three numbers to another reciprocal basis changes the physical wave vector. Use `M` and the corresponding bases to check the phase, then explain why the little group and the representation dimensions change.
结构取自 [Phonopy 的 Si-QHA 原始 POSCAR-0](http: The structure is from the [original Phonopy Si-QHA POSCAR-0](https://github.com/phonopy/phonopy/blob/18cad919af8fe8aad349e04f101887fa19b051a0/example/Si-QHA/POSCAR-0).
